## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete problem and what users experience after this change.

## Validation

List checks run and their results, plus any checks not run and why. Include
reproduction steps and screenshots for UI changes; include large-dataset
responsiveness results for renderer changes.

- [ ] Reproducible validation steps provided for changed behavior.
- [ ] Compile check, Source Gate, and resource inventory pass.
- [ ] Architecture and UI conventions followed; light/dark QA where applicable.
- [ ] Release-relevant change recorded under Unreleased; no routine version bump.
- [ ] No credentials, personal collections, or generated build output included.
